item.title: Heights Garden Club Presents: Angel Wing Arts brings this Bee Watering Station Craft to the Heights Garden Club
item.description:
Wednesday, August 26, 2026 at 6:30 PM

Location: Houston Heights City Hall & Fire Station, 107 W. 12th Street, Houston, TX, 77008, United States

AUGUST 26th at 6:30pm, join us at the Heights Fire Station Carolyn, of Angel Wing Arts, (Instagram @cacoatesart or @anglewingarts) and one of our own, will lead this workshop. Carolyn has been active in the arts for over 30 years, from faux finishes to murals to art pieces. She has worked with clients and their art needs, and her work itself is whimsical and fun. Please join us on August 26, at our favorite spot to mingle, the historic Heights Fire station on 12th and Yale streets. There will be a demo, and plenty of inspiration to kick off your creativity!! Each participant will construct two bee watering stations from clay pots and saucers and then decorate them with paints and pens, as seen in the photo. Let’s help our bees and butterflies in this heat by providing them a safe place to get a drink that YOU are providing with your cute, personalized vessel. Reserve your spot through Sign-Up Genius so we have an accurate headcount and can make sure we have the right amount of supplies on hand. But hurry, there is only room for 25 guests and the deadline to sign up is August 19th. $20 cash per person, ages 12 and up, to be paid at the door. Please, no unaccompanied minors. Doors opens at 6:30pm, Class is 7-9pm. Please arrive early so that instruction can begin on time. Water and some light refreshments will be provided, but please consider bringing a snack to share, if you are so inclined. You may bring your own adult beverages if you wish.  

From Houston Heights Association

item.title: Speakeasy Casino Night
item.description:
Friday, October 2, 2026 at 6 PM

Houston Heights Association · Est. 1973 SpeakeasyCasino Nightin the Heights One night, back in the Prohibition era. Casino tables, cocktails, live entertainment, a silent auction and raffle — and the whole neighborhood in one room. Every dollar stays in the Heights. DateFriday, October 2, 2026 Time7:00 – 10:30 pm WhereThe Historic Houston Heights Fire Station107 W 12th Street, Houston, TX 77008 Admission$100 per guestIncludes gaming chips, food & drink Get tickets — $100 Become an underwriter Admission One night only Speakeasy Ticket $100per guest Entry for one, 7:00 to 10:30 pm Starting stack of gaming chips for the tables Heavy hors d’oeuvres and cocktails Live entertainment and dancing Access to the silent auction and raffle How many are coming? − + 1 ticket $100.00 Add to cart → The evening What the night looks like Doors at seven, password at the door. Come dressed for 1926 if you like — flapper, pinstripe, or just your good jacket. Casino tables Blackjack, roulette, poker and craps, run by dealers all evening. Chips come with your ticket. Cocktails & bites Period cocktails at the bar and heavy hors d’oeuvres circulating all night. Silent auction & raffle Neighborhood-donated packages, experiences and prizes — bid from your table. Live entertainment Music, dancing, and a stage program — plus a few surprises we’re not printing here. Why it matters A $40,000 night for the neighborhood Casino Night is a fundraiser first. What we raise on October 2 goes directly into the programs neighbors actually see — the boulevard, the parks, the constable patrol, the home tour, and the small grants we make each spring. More than 150 residents and guests are expected. The Houston Heights Association is a volunteer-led nonprofit, and this is one of the few nights a year the whole neighborhood is in one room. $40,000Fundraising goal 150+Neighbors expected 100%Stays in the Heights Sponsorship Put your name on the night Three underwriting levels, each with tickets included and your name or logo on event materials, signage and communications. Read the full details below, or download either document to share.
